_instructions.rotation: Captions are used in order (1, 2, 3...) and cycle back to the start when all have been used. Set 'used' back to false to reuse a caption.
_instructions.media_folder: Place your photos/videos in the 'media/' folder next to this file. They will be posted in alphabetical order.
